description: "Fly Leaves" by Charles Stuart Calverley is a collection of humorous and whimsical poetry written during the late 19th century, specifically in the Victorian era. Reflecting the playful use of language and a light-hearted tone, the book likely explores themes of love, nature, and human folly through its various verses.
